organizer.general:
***ALL PARTICIPANTS MUST BE TICKETED: This event will take place inside of the Indianapolis Motor Speedway facility. Since it coincides with a race, everyone 16 and older must be ticketed for the ENTIRE WEEKEND of Speedway: Override. All coaches have received emails regarding how to request tickets for their team(s). Coaches, if you have not already, please go into your team portal on Speedwaysig,org to request your tickets. Additionally, you should have completed the Vehicle/Parking Survey that was sent to you via email. If you have questions, please reach out to [email protected].

THE GREATEST SPECTACLE IN ROBOTICS returns to Indiana for its seventh thrilling run at the Speedway Signature Event—hosted at the legendary Indianapolis Motor Speedway, the largest spectator sporting venue in the world. Each year, it hosts the iconic Indy500, the premier event in IndyCar racing.

This September, 105 teams will battle for the chance to qualify for the 2027 VEX Robotics World Championship™, drink the famous victory milk, be crowned Champions of the Speedway, and earn their rightful place in the prestigious Speedway Signature Event Hall of Fame.

This year, we're proud to share that Speedway will coincide with an on-track race at the IMS — giving students the rare opportunity to compete in a world-class STEM event and watch professional racing teams take the track at the world's largest spectator sporting venue, all in the same weekend.

Speedway features top-tier, world-class referees and announcers, a heartfelt “Final Lap” senior ceremony, thematic elements unique to the Speedway experience, and surprises you won’t want to miss. Speedway has hosted VEX Robotics® World Champions, World Division Champions, and World Excellence Award winners

Mark your calendars: September 18th-20th in Speedway, Indiana. The green flag is ready. Are you? 

Start your robots—the race for robotics glory is about to begin!

Click here to view the 2025 Speedway Signature Event highlight video.

The Speedway Signature Event will offer five spots to the 2027 VEX Robotics World Championship™.

	• Tournament Champions (x2)

	• High School Excellence Award

	• Middle School Excellence Award

	• Skills Champion*

* Award Allocation Variance: At the Event Partner’s request, a variance was granted allowing this event to deviate from the currently posted award chart due to the timing of its original award allocation and publication. The qualifying awards listed above reflect the approved allocation for this event.

Disclaimers:

	•
	Everything on this schedule is subject to change. The track will be hot for a racing event. It is possible that, due to factors outside our control, elements of the schedule may need to be adjusted. We will communicate these changes here and in the venue throughout the event. To be clear: this schedule is subject to change at any time. 

	•
	Skills fields will close at the end of qualification matches, even if the event is ahead of schedule. Only teams on the field at the end of the last qualification match will be able to complete their skills run. 

	•
	The elimination match schedule, in particular, is entirely dependent upon the flow of the event. Rules questions, timeouts, and other considerations may speed up or slow down the event. 

	•
	As is typically true at Indiana events, there will be a five-minute break between the quarterfinals and semi-finals matches and a ten-minute break between the semi-finals and finals pre-show (regardless of any timeouts).
organizer.travel:
The Speedway Signature Event is held in the Gallagher Pavillion on Pagoda Plaza — inside the track at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway, the home of the Indianapolis 500. Maps will be sent in follow-up communications.

For those driving to the Speedway Signature Event, we recommend putting in your destination as the Indianapolis Motor Speedway Museum. Use Gate 2 and the South Side Tunnel on 16th Street.
